name: k3d in Codespace (recommended)
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl jq && curl -s https://get.k3d.io | bash && curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -L -s https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl" && chmod +x kubectl && sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
